title: Assistant Professor of Developmental Biology
bio: Dr. Rosalyn Sulyanto is a full-time staff member of the Department of Dentistry at Boston Children's Hospital and is a diplomate of the American Board of Pediatric Dentistry. Sulyanto received her DMD from the Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM), where she conducted research on bone development as a Howard Hughes Medical Institute Fellow. She completed her residency in pediatric dentistry at The Ohio State University/Nationwide Children’s Hospital, where she was awarded the 3M ESPE Preventive Pediatric Dentistry Postdoctoral Research Fellowship, the Ralph E. McDonald Award, and a master’s degree in dentistry. She serves on the editorial board of Special Care in Dentistry Journal and is a reviewer for Pediatric Dentistry, the journal of the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry. Her research interests include pediatric oral microbiology and the prevention and management of caries. Alphabetical listing S Department or Program Developmental Biology Pediatric Dentistry
